Title: Investigador(a) Postdoc CFC
Description: Ser parte del Tecnológico de Monterrey significa que tendrás la oportunidad de colaborar en una comunidad centrada en la educación, la innovación, la investigación y excelencia para transformar positivamente nuestro entorno. Aquí puedes potenciar tu talento y desarrollarte con un próposito trascendental: imaginar, emprender y construir soluciones que impactan positivamente a las personas y a la comunidad. ¡Esta oportunidad es para ti! Únete al tec y transforma el futuro junto a nosotros ¿Qué harás? Siendo Investigador(a) Postdoc CFC el reto principal es traducir los escenarios de crecimiento urbano que genera el simulador del Centro en representaciones visuales realistas y fieles al sitio real, en lugar de imágenes genéricas. ¿Cómo lo harás? Tus principales retos serán: Diseñar modelos de inteligencia artificial capaces de generar imágenes realistas a partir de los datos de planeación urbana. Construir procesos que garanticen que las imágenes generadas reflejen fielmente los cambios definidos en cada escenario (como altura, densidad o alineamiento de construcciones), evitando resultados genéricos o poco confiables. Integrar información geográfica y volumétrica del territorio como base para la generación de las imágenes. Definir métricas objetivas para evaluar la calidad y coherencia de los resultados generados, incluso cuando no existan datos de referencia con los cuales comparar.Representar visualmente el rango de resultados posibles y su nivel de incertidumbre, para apoyar la toma de decisiones. Documentar e integrar estos desarrollos como capacidades permanentes dentro de las herramientas del Centro. ¿Qué buscamos? Si tienes formación de doctorado en un área cuantitativa (matemáticas, física, estadística, ciencias de la computación, ingeniería, visión computacional, ciencia de datos, o urbanismo/diseño con formación cuantitativa), has tenido la experiencia de trabajar con modelos generativos de imágenes, y entre tus habilidades se encuentran la programación sólida en Python, el control de versiones y el diseño de esquemas de evaluación de modelos. ¡Te estamos buscando, postúlate ya! ¡Síguenos! GM Financial is the wholly owned captive finance subsidiary of General Motors and is headquartered in Fort Worth, U.S. We are a global provider of auto finance solutions, with operations in North America, South America, and the Asia Pacific region. Through our long-standing relationships with auto dealers, we offer attractive retail financing and lease programs to meet the needs of each customer. Responsibilities About the role: The IO CX Management Senior Specialist (P4) owns the operational administration, governance, data strategy, quality, and analytical enablement of the International Operations (IO) Voice of the Customer (VoC) ecosystem. The position will combine advanced analytics with experience and operational data to transform structured and unstructured customer feedback into statistical findings and actionable insights that inform priorities, strengthen decision-making, and improve customer and business outcomes. Also, it serves as the technical and analytical expert for Qualtrics XM Engage and XM Discover, related reporting platforms, and the controlled integration of experience, operational, digital, and conversational data. With solid understanding of data sources, data flows, data architecture and tools, it establishes and strengths the data strategy, data standards and data governance to be aligned with the corporate policies and standards. The role directs cross-functional delivery without requiring formal authority, manages risks and dependencies, coaches platform users and analytical partners, and is accountable for the reliability, scalability, adoption, and continuous improvement of CXM data products and platforms across IO markets. In This Role You Will CXM Data Strategy and Governance Own and execute the VoC data strategy roadmap, translating the approved CXM strategy into governed capabilities, milestones, controls, and measurable outcomes across IO markets. Establish and maintain standards for VoC data architecture, taxonomy, metadata, metric definitions, access, retention, lineage, documentation, and change control. Integrate experience data with operational, digital, transactional, and conversational inputs to improve insight quality and enable Qualtrics as the controlled source of truth for VoC. Lead structured pilots of modern data and AI capabilities, including Databricks and Qualtrics AI, with documented use cases, validation criteria, risks, controls, and adoption recommendations. Partner with CX IO, IT, Business Intelligence, Privacy, Compliance, Legal, vendors, and operational/functional teams to resolve dependencies and ensure compliant, scalable solutions. Develop and maintain VoC dashboards and insights reporting to the management team across all international markets. Qualtrics and Reporting Platforms Administration Serve as the senior administrator and product owner for Qualtrics XM Engage and XM Discover, including configuration standards, user access, roles, directories, workflows, dashboards, distributions, text analytics, and release/change governance. Own platform health routines, usage monitoring, issue logs, enhancement backlog, vendor escalation, license utilization, and business continuity controls. Design and govern survey and reporting solutions across relational and transactional programs, ensuring consistent triggers, questionnaires, embedded data, routing, notifications, close-the-loop workflows, and market comparability. Evaluate new platform capabilities and recommend adoption based on business value, technical feasibility, risk, data quality, and operating impact. Create and maintain technical documentation, configuration inventories, process maps, data dictionaries, operating procedures, and audit evidence. Own business configuration and governance decisions for the CXM platform ecosystem within approved enterprise policies and technical guardrails. Data Quality, Controls and Reporting Own scheduled survey, platform, data, and reporting quality assurance, including, weekly, monthly QA before report distribution, documented evidence, issue tracking, root-cause analysis, corrective actions, and prevention controls. Collaborate with Business Intelligence and IT to maintain Customer Data Platform including new enhancements that might be required by the business. Establish reconciliation and validation controls across source data, Qualtrics, Power BI, dashboards, recurring reports, and distributed outputs. Develop and maintain role-based dashboards and executive reporting that provide reliable self-service visibility while reducing manual production and inconsistent interpretation. Define service levels, quality thresholds, escalation paths, and performance measures for critical VoC data and platform processes. Identify control gaps and lead corrective improvements to protect the accuracy, confidentiality, availability, and traceability of customer feedback data. Escalate material data, platform, compliance, vendor, or delivery risks and recommend corrective action. Advanced Analytics and Customer Intelligence Lead analysis of NPS, OSAT, CES, IRR, and other experience measures using statistically valid methods that distinguish directional findings from decision-grade evidence. Develop and standardize driver-impact analysis, regression or key-driver models, segmentation, forecasting, experimentation, and impact estimation to identify the customer experience improvements that matter most. Define analytical standards and determine whether results are sufficiently reliable for reporting, prioritization, or executive decision-making. Build a consistent text analytics discipline using common taxonomies, topic modeling, sentiment, and root-cause analysis across open-text, chat, messaging, and call or conversation inputs. Analyze complex datasets using SQL, Python, R, SAS/JMP, Excel, Power BI, or equivalent tools; automate repeatable data preparation, validation, analysis, and reporting where appropriate. Present technical methods, limitations, findings, and recommendations in plain language for executives, markets, operations, and cross-functional teams. Projects, Initiatives and Stakeholder Management Prioritize the CXM data and platform backlog based on strategic value, customer impact, risk, feasibility, capacity, and cross-market scalability. Lead cross-functional workstreams and technical delivery through clear direction, operating routines, decision rights, milestones, risks, and accountability, including when contributors do not formally report to the role. Participate in regular communications and meetings with the North American and IO Customer Experience teams, as well as branch level IO Stakeholders to ensure effective coordination between groups Build networks with CXM leaders, market teams, IT, Data, Analytics, Digital, Operations, vendors, and Centers of Excellence to secure expertise and deliver shared objectives. Coach and enable users on platform standards, data literacy, statistical interpretation, dashboard use, text analytics, and quality controls. Communicate changes, address resistance, support adoption, and monitor whether new processes and capabilities deliver the intended results. Provide concise updates on delivery, risks, decisions, platform health, data quality, adoption, and business impact to CXM leadership and stakeholders. Advanced English (written and spoken) Strong written and verbal presentation skills; ability to communicate effectively with senior management and cross-functional teams. Advanced proficiency in Python, SQL, and JMP (Required). Advanced proficiency in Excel and Power BI (Required). Advanced knowledge of SAS and R (Preferred). VBA programming skills (Preferred). Description: Ser parte del Tecnológico de Monterrey significa que tendrás la oportunidad de colaborar en una comunidad centrada en la educación, la innovación, la investigación y excelencia para transformar positivamente nuestro entorno. Siendo Investigador/a Postdoctoral el reto principal es generar y transferir conocimiento de frontera sobre los procesos de enseñanza-aprendizaje en la educación superior y el aprendizaje permanente, a través de investigación científica de alto impacto. ¿Cómo lo harás? Participar en la ideación de proyectos, postulación a fondos externos y registro de propiedad intelectual. Difundir resultados de investigación en eventos y foros relacionados con la investigación interdisciplinaria en educación. ¿Qué buscamos?
